description: Import a public HTTPS song, artist photo or reference into the same private attachment pipeline as an upload. projectId is optional in the schema but required to attach media: omission returns guidance to select a project, never another user project. Refuses private/loopback destinations, unsafe redirects, DNS rebinding, invalid file types, oversized downloads and slow sources. Song/photo replacement rules remain unchanged. Identical reference bytes in the same project replay the existing asset. Returns assetId and status; no provider or language model is called.

projectId.description: The project receiving the file. Required for song, Artist DNA (artist is derived from the project) and reference attachment; no project is selected implicitly.

purpose.description: The customer file role; this never selects a paid generation.

url.description: A direct public HTTPS media URL, port 443, without user credentials.

name: studio_media_import_url
title: Import public HTTPS media
